findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_visa_condition" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_course, get_occupation_courses, get_rto, get_rto_regulatory_actions, get_visa_case, list_advisors, open_application_form · Private data: get_state_dama_agreements, get_state_nomination, get_state_nomination_detail, get_state_nomination_occupations, get_visa_condition, open_application_form, prepare_application_restart · Public sink: list_advisors, open_application_form, prepare_application_submission · Destructive: prepare_application_submission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_course, get_occupation_courses, get_rto, get_rto_regulatory_actions, get_visa_case, list_advisors, open_application_form · Private data: get_state_dama_agreements, get_state_nomination, get_state_nomination_detail, get_state_nomination_occupations, get_visa_condition, open_application_form, prepare_application_restart · Public sink: list_advisors, open_application_form, prepare_application_submission · Destructive: prepare_application_submission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
